headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Hayward ProLogic/AquaLogic/AquaPlus pool controllers. Talks to the panel through the Python sidecar service — either the AquaConnect HTTP box or a Raspberry Pi RS-485 pad bridge. See the README for setup.
footerDisplay: See the [README](https://github.com/homebridge-fun/homebridge-prologic) for wiring and setup instructions.

sidecarHost.title: Sidecar Host
sidecarHost.description: Host where the Python sidecar service is running (usually localhost on the same Pi).

sidecarPort.title: Sidecar Port
sidecarPort.description: Port for the Python sidecar REST API.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (ms)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll the sidecar for state updates.

backend.title: Sidecar Backend

oneOf.title: RS-485 Smart Bridge (pad Pi, direct serial)

backend.description: Which navigation backend the sidecar should use. Changing this restarts the sidecar to apply. 'RS-485 Smart Bridge' is the recommended direct-serial path: a small daemon on a pad-mounted Pi owns the serial link (100% reliable keypresses), reached over Tailscale. 'AquaConnect' drives the HTTP web box (fallback).

aquaconnectHost.title: AquaConnect Host
aquaconnectHost.description: IP of the AquaConnect web box on your LAN (used when backend = aquaconnect). Required for that backend — there is deliberately no default, since guessing an address would point at whatever device happens to occupy it. Find it in your router's client list.

rs485bridgeHost.title: RS-485 Smart Bridge Host
rs485bridgeHost.description: Host of the pad-Pi smart bridge daemon (used when backend = rs485bridge). Use either the Tailscale tailnet IP (e.g. 100.x.y.z) or, if Tailscale MagicDNS is enabled and the Homebridge host accepts tailnet DNS (`tailscale set --accept-dns=true`; verify with `getent hosts <name>`), the MagicDNS name (e.g. 'pool'). The name survives a tailnet-IP change; the IP avoids a DNS dependency.

rs485bridgePort.title: RS-485 Smart Bridge Port
rs485bridgePort.description: HTTP port of the pad-Pi smart bridge daemon (used when backend = rs485bridge).

circuits.title: Circuit switches to expose
circuits.description: Which circuits to expose as HomeKit switches. AUX_2 and VALVE_3 are hidden by default (unused on this system).

activeBodies.title: Active pool bodies
activeBodies.description: Which bodies your panel is configured for. Controls the POOL/SPA mode-selection cycle and which heater setpoints are active. This system: pool + spa only (no spillover).

enableActiveHeaterThermostat.title: Heat Thermostat (mode-following, recommended)
enableActiveHeaterThermostat.description: Expose the single mode-following thermostat that mirrors whichever heater setpoint is active for the current valve mode (name shows 'Heat — Pool' or 'Heat — Spa'). One physical heater = one tile.

enableSpaLightScenes.title: Spa Light Scenes (HomeKit tile)
enableSpaLightScenes.description: Expose the spa light as a Television-style tile whose input picker selects a color scene. Added as a separate accessory you pair in the Home app. Requires the RS-485 Smart Bridge backend. Set the standard and relay with spaLightType / spaLightCircuit.

spaLightType.title: Spa Light Standard
spaLightType.description: Which light standard is wired to this body. The two select colours differently, so getting this wrong means scenes land on the wrong colour. Only power-cycle-controlled lights are supported — Hayward OmniDirect (networked ColorLogic on OmniLogic) is a different platform and is not supported.

spaLightCircuit.title: Spa Light Relay
spaLightCircuit.description: Which relay the spa light is wired to on your panel.

enablePoolLightScenes.title: Pool Light Scenes (HomeKit tile)
enablePoolLightScenes.description: Expose the pool light as a Television-style tile whose input picker selects a color scene. Added as a separate accessory you pair in the Home app. Requires the RS-485 Smart Bridge backend. Set the standard and relay with poolLightType / poolLightCircuit.

poolLightType.title: Pool Light Standard
poolLightType.description: Which light standard is wired to this body. The two select colours differently, so getting this wrong means scenes land on the wrong colour. Only power-cycle-controlled lights are supported — Hayward OmniDirect (networked ColorLogic on OmniLogic) is a different platform and is not supported.

poolLightCircuit.title: Pool Light Relay
poolLightCircuit.description: Which relay the pool light is wired to on your panel.

spaLightSceneList.title: Spa Light Scenes — order & names
spaLightSceneList.description: Optional: choose which spa scenes appear in HomeKit, in what order (drag to reorder), with custom names. Leave empty to show all 12 in default order. Spa program numbers: 1 SAm, 2 Party, 3 Romance, 4 Caribbean, 5 American, 6 California Sunset, 7 Royal, 8 Blue, 9 Green, 10 Red, 11 White, 12 Magenta.

poolLightSceneList.title: Pool Light Scenes — order & names
poolLightSceneList.description: Optional: choose which pool scenes appear in HomeKit, in what order (drag to reorder), with custom names. Leave empty to show all in default order. Pool program numbers: 1 Voodoo Lounge, 2 Deep Blue Sea, 3 Royal Blue, 4 Afternoon Skies, 5 Aqua Green, 6 Emerald, 7 Cloud White, 8 Warm Red, 9 Flamingo, 10 Vivid Violet, 11 Sangria, 12 Twilight, 13 Tranquility, 14 Gemstone, 15 USA, 16 Mardi Gras, 17 Cool Cabaret.

enableTemperatureSensors.title: Temperature Sensors
enableTemperatureSensors.description: Expose read-only air and pool temperature sensors.

enableChlorinatorFan.title: Chlorinator Fan
enableChlorinatorFan.description: Expose pool chlorinator output % as a Fan accessory (speed ring = output %). Read/write via Settings menu navigation.

enableSaltSensor.title: Salt Level Sensor
enableSaltSensor.description: Expose salt level (PPM) as an Air Quality sensor tile.

circuitLabels.title: Circuit Label Overrides
circuitLabels.description: Custom display names for circuit switches in HomeKit. Leave a field blank to use the default name.
